title: Paletero Vibora Mamba Pro Amarillo - Vibora
description:
VIBORA MAMBA PRO YELLOW PADEL BAG - The best Vibora padel bag. To carry all your material. It is big, beautiful and made with the best materials.
 *** AESTHETIC DEFECT *** Enjoy the largest and most complete Vibora padel racket bag. The VIBORA MAMBA PRO YELLOW PADEL BAG has it all. In it, we will find 4 large, well-differentiated compartments:

- 1 very large compartment in the center with a smooth opening to store our clothes or sports equipment.

- 1 side compartment with thermal system to store padel rackets and leave them well protected.

- 1 side compartment also intended for paddle tennis rackets, in case you want to take a complete arsenal to the courts.

- 1 very spacious compartment for padel shoes.

This VIBORA MAMBA PRO YELLOW PADEL BAG is your best value for money option.
